{{Quote|These modified chromium-plated pistols were manufactured by Theed Arms and presented to Captain Rex to thank him for helping prevent the deadly Blue Shadow Virus from being released on Naboo.|In-game description|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
The '''Negotiator''' was a custom [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]] manufactured by [[Theed Arms/Legends|Theed Arms]] and later awarded to [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], for his part in [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|preventing]] the release of the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Negotiator&mdash;like its counterpart, the [[Vigilance (DC-17 hand blaster)|Vigilance]]&mdash;was specially plated with [[Chromium/Legends|chromium]].<ref name="CWA" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Negotiator could only be obtained by participating in the first anniversary celebration of the [[2010]] video game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']], but became purchasable afterwards for 299 [[:w:c:cwa:Station Cash|Station Cash]]. Simply logging into the game on [[September 16]], [[2011]] would grant the player the Negotiator as a free gift.<ref name="CWA" />
